summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HEMELEY iteration 6 features: New Uber Eats-style homepage with 10 zones, categories, sort/filter, discount badges, crossed prices. Fixed backend bug where original_price, discount_percent, category, visibility dates were not being saved during menu creation. All 9 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed.
passed_tests: Homepage loads with Uber Eats style - 4 column grid of menus
Header shows 'Connexion' button when not logged in
Header shows user pseudo (TestClient) when customer logged in
Zone filter bar shows all 10 quartiers (Bonapriso, Akwa, Deido, Bonamoussadi, Bepanda, Makepe, Bonanjo, Ndokotti, Logbessou, Kotto)
Clicking a zone filters menus to that zone only
Category filter works (Tout, Plats, Petit-déj, Boissons, Desserts, Snacks)
Sort/Trier button opens sort options (Populaire, Prix ↑, Prix ↓, Meilleur avis, Plus récent)
Search input filters menus by name/vendor/description
Menu cards show: vendor name (clickable), menu name, description, rating, zone, time, price, + button
Menu cards show discount badge (-20%) and crossed price (2,500) when original_price is set
Footer shows links to client, vendor, and delivery login
Vendor add menu form has category select (5 options)
Vendor add menu form has zone select (10 zones)
Vendor add menu form has original_price (prix barré) input
Vendor add menu form has discount_percent (auto-calculated) input
Vendor add menu form has visibility_start and visibility_end date inputs
Backend menu model accepts category, original_price, discount_percent, visibility_start, visibility_end
Mobile responsive - homepage works on 390px viewport
Customer login works and shows pseudo in header
Customer logout works and shows Connexion button
GET /api/menus?zone={zone} works for all 10 zones
POST /api/vendor/menus creates menu with all new fields
Vendor login works

bugs_fixed.issue: Menu creation was not saving original_price, discount_percent, category, visibility_start, visibility_end fields
bugs_fixed.fix: Added missing fields to Menu() constructor in create_menu function

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed menus during testing to verify discount badge and crossed price display
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 homepage refactoring complete.
